title: Tenma Saki — Embracing Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The girls have improved yet again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, didn't we just get through that song with no mistakes?! Even though it was a tough Miku song?!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
What's more, you've gone from struggling with it the last time to really making it your own today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right... Each sound was firmly present, even for the fast parts, so it felt good listening to it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And this song has a complex rhythm, but the drums were steady all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I also think that performance showed the progress we've made in our practices.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, we got Shiho's seal of approval♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this means...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Didn't we clear this one?!
“Learn to play a difficult practice song without making mistakes!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh... That's the “100 New Things I Want To Do” list you made that time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You wrote things you want to do with Leo/need as a supplement to your “100 Things I Want To Do” list, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Though, I feel like most of them were closer to goals, like “Headline an event”.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Right!
I also got Rin and the others to write the things they wanna do! Look!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... “Wear a complete outfit of Leo/need merch☆”...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is that what you wrote?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was thinking I really wanna wear a T-shirt with the Leo/need logo or drawings of everybody's faces on it☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A T-shirt... Yeah, you often see those for sale as merchandise.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If it's going to be a complete outfit, we should have other things like hats and tote bags, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ooh, nice!
Alright, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks to you guys, I managed to accomplish everything I had on my list...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanna accomplish all the stuff on this one too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... I agree!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's all do our best to accomplish the things we want to do, and everything Rin and the others wrote for us too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll be here to help, of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'll go ahead and give this “no mistakes” one a check mark and a fun little doodle, and—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait a second.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did manage to make it all the way through just now, but it might've been a fluke... Don't you think it's too soon to check that one off?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Shiho, you're so strict...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Shiho, ever the drill sergeant.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, given the shape we're in right now, we'll probably be able to check it off right away... I just don't want to settle.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Girls. There's one more you should all be accomplishing before long. Just look at the first page...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Shiho, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: “We're going pro!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's the one we wanted to accomplish the most, so I wrote it suuuper huge across the first two pages♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. When we made this list, we'd just started performing at live houses and were still only taking our first steps, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're going to make our debut.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just a little longer...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Once we debut, more people than ever will be listening to us play.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And to bring them an even higher level of performance when that happens—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All we can do is practice! Right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do our absolute best to prepare for our debut!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
